flow_descriptions.home: Observed sample: Monday 28 -> Tuesday 29 (Today), with continuous Home scrolling and synthetic DEMO agenda. Apps launched from Home preserves its caller and scroll through the recorded All -> Campus -> Study -> IT Tips -> Health -> Wellness -> Job -> All chain; VRS detail and empty login close one layer at a time. All seven category-state Back buttons were replayed from Monday Home. Direct Monday/Tuesday and legacy Home returns passed. Arbitrary category switching, service links beyond the VRS sample, other module returns and full native scroll extent remain incomplete. Week/Menu/Search/Notification returns cover recorded Home entries only. Other dates, card details, search input/results, Week picker, sheet expansion, drawer background and intermittent images remain unresolved. Agent replay is not native observation or human usability testing.
flow_descriptions.apps: Standalone Apps reference. For the tested interactive Apps journey and correct return behavior, launch Apps from a Home flow. The Home-launched implementation uses one category overlay, nested VRS detail and empty-login overlays, and one-layer close actions. Tested: All -> Campus -> VRS detail -> empty login -> detail -> Campus -> Study -> IT Tips -> Health -> Wellness -> Job -> category-strip drag -> All -> original Home; category Back buttons also return directly to Home. Standalone start has no Home caller and its exit semantics are not verified. Category switching only follows the recorded chain; arbitrary tabs/scrolling and other service links remain unimplemented. Loading is a static reference skipped in playback. No credentials or login submission. Agent replay is separate from native observation and human testing.
